quests.title: One icicle, there and back
quests.ask: Write `harvest_icicle()`: from a floor cell facing east, collect every gem hanging above it and end back on that same cell, facing east.
quests.nudge: There may be empty cells below the icicle. How does the robot know it has climbed high enough?

quests.title: Every icicle along the floor
quests.ask: Write `harvest_cave()`: from the west end of the floor, clear every icicle, the ones at both ends too, and stop at the east end facing east.
quests.nudge: Count the icicles and the steps between them. Are there as many steps as icicles?

quests.title: Back to the start
quests.ask: Write `return_home()`: from the east end of the floor, facing east, go back to the west end and face east again.
quests.nudge: Which way is the robot facing when it arrives? Is that the way the goal asks for?
